items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Olivia. But they had Tony Jackson played piano with him.

ctx.x: It was Adam Olivier, from uptown. Olivia. Up on Chappapulis. I know Buck Johnson used to talk about him. Olivier. I think he played violin, the, uh, leader. He was a barber too. I can't.
Maybe too many. Olivia. But they had Tony Jackson played piano with him.

For a while, when he was a kid. And Buck started out with him. Up near, uh, near Amelia in the Chappapulis. I think they had a barber shop. Uh, do you remember the Peyton band? Peyton. I forget his first name. I think he was an accordion player.
